rulesFrozen.name: NCR Status Classification Rule
rulesFrozen.description: Standardizes the exact matching sequence of statuses for open, closed, under review, and approved NCR items.

rulesFrozen.name: SLA Response Validation Metric
rulesFrozen.description: Enforces a maximum 14-day consultant turnaround. Items older than 14 days without responses are classified as overdue.

rulesFrozen.name: Revision Control Uniqueness Sequence
rulesFrozen.description: Determines the latest revision weight using alphanumeric sequence order and excludes duplicates.

formulasFrozen.name: SLA Delayed Ratio Velocity
formulasFrozen.formula: (Overdue Pending NCRs + Overdue Closed NCRs) / Total Monthly Submissions

formulasFrozen.name: Carry Forward Pending
formulasFrozen.formula: COUNT(Pending where Submission Date < Reporting Period Start)

formulasFrozen.name: Current Month Pending
formulasFrozen.formula: COUNT(Pending where Submission Date >= Reporting Period Start)

formulasFrozen.name: Open Status Deconstruction
formulasFrozen.formula: Open = Under Review + Pending + Workflow Waiting + Other Active States

formulasFrozen.name: Total Pending Balance
formulasFrozen.formula: Pending = Carry Forward Pending + Current Month Pending
